messages:
maya: idea  tiny office contest: 'mini windowsill wreaths' + a quick 'microwave hot-chocolate hack' thread. bring a pic of your windowsill or balcony wreath (max 2 photos) and the one hot-choc trick you swear by. winner gets a tiny potted pine from me :evergreen_tree: 

josh: hell yes. can we do a 'people's choice' vote? i have a super ugly-but-cozy wreath to submit. 

priya: 2 photos ok? i have a cat photobombing one of mine. :cat: 

gabe: count me in. hot-choc hack: cinnamon stick + pinch of flaky salt. game changer. 

keiko: omg flaky salt. also, is this just for in-office or remote folks too? i'm remote in tokyo. 

maya: remote welcome!! post a balcony/door/window shot, or a min DIY (even a screenshot of your video call background with a wreath). i'll make a tiny collage and a poll. 

ops-bot: Poll created: "Mini Wreath People's Choice" (ends in 24h). 

josh: mini rules suggestion: 1) max 2 images 2) 1-sentence backstory 3) optional hot-choc tip 4) tag "#wreath-2026" in the post 

priya: i'll put mine up in a few. quick hot-choc hack i love: 
```
- 2 tbsp cocoa powder
- 1 tbsp brown sugar
- pinch flaky salt
- 150ml water to bloom the cocoa, then 150ml milk, microwave 60-75s, whisk.
- finish with a toasted marshmallow on a skewer.
```

gabe: putting mine now. photo is a 4cm wreath i made from dried orange slices and twine. backstory: made during a 20-min crafting sprint with my niece. 

keiko: uploading - tiny bamboo wreath + paper cranes. hot-choc hack: grate a sliver of 70% chocolate on top, instant adult vibes. 

josh: uploaded: 'josh_wreath1.jpg' (warning: may be aggressively plaid) :plaid: :laughing: 

maya: love the diversity. quick note for remote folks who want physical prize: i'll mail a tiny plant/sock-pair/hot-choc sachet if you win. if you prefer emoji trophy, that works too. :trophy: 

priya: also, could we share easy wreath supplies list for anyone who wants to make one? i found a cheap kit at the corner store (wire ring + hot glue). 

maya: supply list idea: hot glue, wire ring (6-8cm), dried citrus, ribbon, small sprigs, florist wire. i'll add a link soon. 

ops-bot: Reminder: "Mini Wreath People's Choice" poll closes in 2 hours. 

gabe: tiny PSA: if you're making dried orange slices, bake at 100C ~2hrs. low heat, flip once. smells like christmas. 

josh: voting now. also adding a hot-choc tip: instant coffee pinch for depth. works surprisingly well. 

keiko: voted! also, maya you rock for mailing plants. :seedling: 

maya: aww thanks! results coming after poll ends. gratitude for all the cute photos. will post montage + winner around 5pm. :sparkles: 

priya: this made my afternoon. also -- can we do this quarterly? seasonal desk things are fun. 

maya: i am down for quarterly micro-contests. maybe 'spring windowsill herb swap' next? 

ops-bot: Event added: "Mini Wreath Collage & Result Post" at 17:00 today (channel: #random).

josh: also pls tell security not to confiscate my 'aggressively plaid' ribbon if they see it in the lobby. :sweat_smile:"
